title: YesStyle first order: CECILIA010 gives 5% as a Reward Code, then 2%
seoTitle: CECILIA010 on YesStyle: 5% on order 1, 2% after
description: At YesStyle, CECILIA010 gives 5% extra on your first order and 2% on later ones, in the Reward Code field. See what changes from one order to the next and what to check first.
metaDescription: CECILIA010 is a YesStyle Reward Code: 5% extra on the first order and 2% on later ones, in the Reward Code field. What to check before your first order.

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: On your first YesStyle order, CECILIA010 gives 5% extra; on later orders, 2%. It is a Reward Code, not a coupon: it goes in the Reward Code field, separate from the coupon field. Before you fill your cart, check that YesStyle delivers to your country.

contentSections.heading: YesStyle first order: what to use
paragraphs: Placing your first order at YesStyle? Use CECILIA010 in the Reward Code field. The store lists 5% on the first order and 2% on later ones.
A code from a coupon site may not work. What counts is the discount line in the order summary, before you pay. The conditions are on the [YesStyle Reward Code page](/en/coupons/yesstyle).

contentSections.heading: A Reward Code is not a coupon
paragraphs: Checkout has two code fields: the coupon field and the Reward Code field. CECILIA010 is a Reward Code and goes in the Reward Code field, so it does not take up the coupon field.

contentSections.heading: What about the second order?
paragraphs: On the second order, CECILIA010 still works, with 2% extra. The code and the field are the same: only the percentage changes.

contentSections.heading: Before your first order: delivery
paragraphs: Before you fill your cart, check your destination: confirm that YesStyle delivers to your country, because the code does not change where the store ships.
Delivery times, shipping costs and taxes for the US, UK, Canada, Australia, Ireland and New Zealand are in the [YesStyle shipping guide](/en/reviews/yesstyle-shipping-us-uk-canada-australia).

contentSections.heading: Where to enter the code
paragraphs: The field name changes depending on the screen. These are the two paths:
bullets: **On the website:** at checkout, the field is called Reward Code. Type CECILIA010 and apply it.
**In the app:** tap Enter Code and type it in the Influencer / Rewards Code field, below Coupon Code. Tap Apply.

image.alt: Three screens of the YesStyle app: the bag with the Coupon or Influencer / Rewards Code line, the Enter Code screen with the Coupon Code and Influencer / Rewards Code fields, and the summary with CECILIA010 applied
image.caption: The three steps in the Android app, on an account in English with delivery to the United States, without placing an order.

postParagraphs: In our app test, the code was accepted and the summary showed an Influencer Code Discount (5% OFF) line. The step-by-step with website screens is in [how to use CECILIA010](/en/reviews/yesstyle-reward-code-coupon-cecilia010).

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Is there a YesStyle first-order code? Yes: CECILIA010 gives 5% extra on the first order and 2% on later ones, in the Reward Code field.
Does CECILIA010 work on a second order? Yes, with 2% extra on later orders.
Which field does CECILIA010 go in? The Reward Code field, separate from the coupon field: it is a Reward Code.
Does CECILIA010 work in the app? Yes: type the code in the Influencer / Rewards Code field on the Enter Code screen.
